title: Assessing continuum channel importance in continuum-discretized coupled-channels via dynamic polarization potential decomposition
summary: A recurring question in continuum-discretized coupled-channels calculations is which continuum channels carry the breakup coupling, both to interpret the reaction and to decide which channels a model space can safely omit. The standard answer is bin deletion: remove a channel, re-solve the coupled equations, and read the change in the elastic $S$ matrix. We show that this cannot isolate an individual channel's contribution.
